tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the curated log of evidence that superintelligence is arriving (benchmarks, agents, science, robotics, compute, statements by accountable people). Returns matching signals with permalinks. Use fetch with a result id for full details and the primary source.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the full record of one signal by its number (id from search): date, category, strength, why it matters, and the primary source link that serves as evidence. Cite the permalink and pass on the source link.

tools.name: latest_signals
tools.description: The most recent signals, newest first. Optionally filter by category.

tools.name: weekly_digest
tools.description: All signals from one editorial week (Monday to Sunday, US Eastern), strongest first. weeks_ago=0 is the current week, 1 the week before.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
